model: Substitute 1MHz closed-loop buffers; not vendor MCP6004 model
myoware: Synthetic RAW output waveform; no validated MyoWare or physiological model
limitations: No op-amp noise, offset, slew/current limit or PSRR; shared midpoint is ideal so crosstalk is not validated.
1Meg resistive ADC loading approximation; switched-capacitor transients and sinc3 response are not simulated in ngspice.
ADC quantization is an ideal separate software model; 16-bit word width does not imply 16 effective bits.
Rail clamps and ESD are not validated by this linear operating-range model.
Supply/reference ripple and battery runtime require physical tests.
